scope: Fresh visual review of all 40 lessons in assignment-1. For each, read the full material script, viewed the complete scene overview and motion overview, and viewed at least one encoded native 1920x1080 frame; MPS Metal includes a second native frame. Scores cover visual composition/readability/math/layout and meaningful motion/object continuity. Findings cite exact scene, beat time from the encoded timeline, and animation source. All 40 lessons also received a second pass over motion-all-scenes.png and its JSON atlas. Each atlas covers every authored scene and samples early, middle, and late native frames from that scene's highest-motion beat. Scores and findings were reassessed against this scene-complete motion evidence and remain unchanged. Evidence is sampled; it excludes continuous playback, full audio listening, and majority-frame inspection. The readiness flag reflects these visual samples. The language-modeling source revision has a separate storyboard review and awaits an encoded MP4 rerender.
